start.desc: On-call queue for legacy-build-orchestrator. Resolve SEC-2401 and submit the smallest policy-compliant remediation with auditable dependency, advisory, implementation, and test evidence.

ticket.desc: SEC-2401: The scanner reports one vulnerable transitive minimist resolution, but the lockfile records more than one incoming parent edge. Inspect the failed workflow logs before changing the lockfile.

ci_failure.desc: Dependency-policy logs identify minimist 1.2.5 in package-lock.json. The scanner summary does not establish the full justification; inspect the frozen lockfile and source records.

lockfile.desc: package-lock.json freezes gulp-util 3.0.8 and subarg 1.0.0 as direct development dependencies and deduplicates their compatible minimist requirements to minimist 1.2.5. Reconstruct every incoming path before selecting an override.

dependency_graph.desc: The frozen dependency index exposes separate records for gulp-util 3.0.8 and subarg 1.0.0. Open https://api.deps.dev/v3/systems/NPM/packages/gulp-util/versions/3.0.8:dependencies and https://api.deps.dev/v3/systems/NPM/packages/subarg/versions/1.0.0:dependencies because a single deduplicated lockfile node may have multiple parents.

parent_0_0.desc: Observed dependency edge: gulp-util 3.0.8 requires minimist ^1.1.0, which permits locked 1.2.5.

parent_1_0.desc: Observed dependency edge: subarg 1.0.0 requires minimist ^1.1.0, which also permits locked 1.2.5.

vulnerable.desc: Resolved shared transitive package minimist 1.2.5. The same locked resolution is reached by every recorded parent path; inspect the reviewed advisory GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h and release evidence.

advisory.desc: GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h: Prototype pollution in setKey through constructor and __proto__ paths. Affected range 1.x before 1.2.6; first fixed release 1.2.6.

release.desc: Release v1.2.6 resolves to 7efb22a518b53b06f5b02a1038a88bd6290c2846. Inspect the implementation and regression-test history links https://api.github.com/repos/minimistjs/minimist/commits/34e20b8461118608703d6485326abbb8e35e1703 and https://api.github.com/repos/minimistjs/minimist/commits/3dbebff0f4436cf946cb6c1e6db606f4b9bded4f before treating the release as verified.

implementation_commit.desc: Commit 34e20b8461118608703d6485326abbb8e35e1703: Rework isConstructorOrProto and reject dangerous trailing key paths. Review index.js.

implementation.desc: index.js: Rework isConstructorOrProto and reject dangerous trailing key paths.

test_commit.desc: Commit 3dbebff0f4436cf946cb6c1e6db606f4b9bded4f: regression evidence in test/proto.js. Inspect the test itself.

regression_test.desc: test/proto.js: Cover trailing __proto__ and constructor keys in dotted options.

safe_candidate.desc: Registry candidate minimist 1.2.6: It is the first non-downgrade release outside the advisory and satisfies both observed ^1.1.0 parent requirements. Submit https://ci.internal/legacy-build-orchestrator/security/verify only after every parent path and code/test evidence has been checked.

target.desc: CI accepted minimist 1.2.6; every parent path and the advisory, code, and test evidence agree.

unrelated_0.desc: vinyl 0.5.3 is present through gulp-util but does not introduce minimist.

unrelated_1.desc: dash-ast 1.0.0 is present through subarg but does not introduce minimist.
